TubeRoom01LIGHT FOLLOWS SOUND.
Connecting…
YOUR ROOM. YOUR RHYTHM.

Make the room move.

Five tubes. One shared pulse. A light show that belongs to you.

From setup to show in three stepsJoin your tube router’s Wi-Fi first.

The atmosphere

08 LOOKS

Made for full tubes and whole rooms.
No tiny equalizer bars.

ROOM VIEW

Velvet pulse

PREVIEW · NO OUTPUT30 FPS ENGINE
The same pixel frames that are sent to your tubes
2D ROOM / TOP VIEW
0°
Drag a tube to move it. Drag its round handle to rotate. Arrow keys nudge the selected tube.
Preview onlyWaiting for audioLOCAL · PRIVATE · OFFLINE READY

Sound & color

NO INPUT

Play music through speakers. Allow microphone access when asked.

BASS
MIDS
AIR
Fine-tune audio

Raise this if quiet-room noise triggers light. For a mixer or USB input, choose it above. Headphone music is not captured by the Mac mic.

THE RIG
Your five tubes
TubeRoom · Designed around your space
ONE-TIME SETUP

Meet your tubes.

Connect this Mac and all five WLED controllers to your dedicated router. Then discover your tubes, or paste their IP addresses below.

Discovery scans one local /24 network. You can always enter an IP manually.

ON / NAMEWLED IP ADDRESSPIXELSTEST

Pixel count means addressable pixels reported by WLED, which can differ from the number of LED chips. “Check & save” reads it automatically.

Connected, but the tube stays dark?

Open the tube’s WLED page → Config → Sync Interfaces. Enable “Receive UDP realtime”, set realtime LED offset to 0, and use whole-strip realtime output (disable “Use main segment only” if present). Close other lighting apps. Allow local network access for Terminal/Node if macOS asks. Your router’s client/AP isolation must be off.

Set WLED’s LED type, color order and power limit correctly first. Keep its brightness limiter enabled. This app sends RGB data; separate RGBW white-channel control is not included.

Your room, in three steps.

  1. Connect. Join the tubes’ router on your Mac. Setup → Find my tubes → Check & save.
  2. Listen. Enable microphone and allow access. Play music through speakers. The Bass / Mids / Air meters should move.
  3. Go. Pick a look, preview it, then Start lights. Edit layout while stopped to match the real room.

Use one shared audio input for all five tubes. The Mac mic is the quickest option; a USB mic or mixer input is selectable for better sound in a loud room. This version does not ingest the controllers’ microphones.

Keep this tab in front and your Mac awake. Stop restores the previous WLED state; Blackout turns the tubes off. Escape is the blackout shortcut. Closing the page stops the show after about four seconds and switches reachable tubes off.

Demo is simulated audio for testing. Open music file plays and analyzes a local track directly. Spotify/Apple Music system audio is not captured directly; use speakers with the mic, or a separately configured loopback input.

Everything runs locally. Microphone samples are analyzed in your browser and are not recorded or uploaded. The preview shows sent RGB values; physical brightness and color also depend on WLED settings, LEDs and diffusion.

After the first runtime install, no internet is needed. Reopen Start-TubeRoom.command next time. Safari address: http://127.0.0.1:8788.
KEEP YOUR SETUP. GET THE IMPROVEMENTS.

App updates

Checking installed version…

Stop the lights before installing. Your tube connections, layout and colors stay saved. The app restarts automatically; enable your microphone again afterward. Choose update files only from this project’s publisher.

Online update source

Once publishing is connected, enter its permanent HTTPS update address here. This is a one-time setting. Updates run app code, so use a source you trust.

If you do not have an address yet, use Install update file. Online checks need internet; lighting control does not.

The previous version is kept for recovery.
